title: Continuous In Zone 2 vs. 2 Game
description: A continuous in-zone 2-on-2 game where the defenders double-shift. Forwards attack to score while defenders try to win possession and skate or pass the puck out to the next forwards.
coaching_points: Defenders communicate through the double shift and maintain strong positioning.
Keep sticks on the ice and protect the middle.
Both teams can hold and protect the puck until a good play is available.
Compete for points with short, intense shifts.

title: Finnish 5 Puck - Rotating Zones
description: A rotating three-zone warm-up where players work through active puck-control and skating tasks in the outside zones while the middle zone is used for stationary passing and recovery.
coaching_points: Keep the head up and scan while controlling the puck in traffic.
Use strong inside edges and sharp lateral movements.
Communicate constantly during passing variations.
Rotate groups on time so the drill maintains rhythm and pace.

title: High Tempo 2 vs. 2 to Net
description: A fast 2-on-2 game where the forwards can attack either net while the defense must react, communicate, and defend both scoring options. The defenders can earn a point by winning the puck and completing consecutive passes.
coaching_points: Forwards explode immediately when possession begins.
Both forwards and defenders communicate continuously.
Players keep their heads up to read pressure and open space.
Use deception and quick changes of direction to attack the opposite net.

title: 4 vs. 2 No Stickhandle Game
description: A half-ice 4-on-2 possession game where offensive players are not allowed to stickhandle. The constraint forces quick puck movement while defenders work to disrupt passing lanes and transition the puck to teammates.
coaching_points: Offensive players make decisions before the puck arrives.
Move immediately into open space after passing.
Defenders keep sticks on the ice and pressure passing lanes.
Use quick puck movement instead of carrying the puck.

title: Corner Puck Protection
description: A corner retrieval and puck-protection drill where the player scans, collects a chipped puck, uses tight turns along the wall to shield possession, then drives the net for a shot.
coaching_points: Shoulder-check before collecting the puck.
Keep the puck along the boards so the body can protect it from pressure.
Use a strong hockey stance through each tight turn.
Progress from no pressure to shadow pressure and then a live 1-on-1.

title: 6 Cone Skills Series
description: A six-cone skating setup used for multiple skill sequences including hard direction changes, tight turns, figure eights, slide-outs, and deceptive shuffle movements.
coaching_points: Maintain an athletic stance with knees bent and chest up.
Practice every movement on both sides.
Keep the head up as comfort and skill improve.
Increase pace only after the movement quality is consistent.

title: Around the World
description: A full-ice puck-control competition where players try to carry their puck around both nets and reach the far end while defenders in the neutral zone attempt to knock pucks away.
coaching_points: Keep the head up to identify defenders and opposing traffic.
Protect the puck while maintaining forward momentum.
Change speed and direction to avoid pressure.
Use the activity as a competitive warm-up with repeated rounds.

title: Three Gates 1 vs 1 vs 1
description: A three-player battle game where all players compete for one puck and score points by carrying the puck through different tire gates.
coaching_points: Puck carrier protects the puck and looks for open gates.
Use deception to create space before attacking a gate.
Defenders work together to angle the puck carrier toward dead areas.
Do not attack the same gate twice in a row.

title: 1 vs 1 vs 1 - Sixth Ice Station
description: A sixth-ice three-player game where each player protects one net and can attack either of the other two. The coach introduces a new puck after each goal.
coaching_points: Scan before attacking so both scoring options are visible.
Protect your own net while looking for chances to transition to offense.
Use body position and puck protection in tight space.
Keep shifts short and restart quickly after goals.

title: Corner Tires 1 vs 1 Multiple Games 1/6 Ice Station
description: A sixth-ice 1-on-1 battle station where multiple games can run simultaneously. Players score by hitting one of the opponent's corner tires with the puck.
coaching_points: Maintain awareness because multiple games may be active in the same space.
Protect the puck before attacking a scoring tire.
Transition immediately after a tire is hit or possession changes.
Use short rounds to keep intensity high.
